customers.evidence: we aim to make a remarkable impact on people’s lives

employees.evidence: their commitment to patients fuels our culture

community.evidence: We’re constantly working to create solutions that go beyond treating the illness to have a positive impact on patients’ lives

integrity.evidence: we pledge to do so in a transparent and sustainable way

innovation.evidence: We come up with new approaches to addressing today’s health issues

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural tone with a 'People. Passion. Possibilities.' tagline. Patients and health outcomes are foregrounded; workforce and financial themes are brief. Commitments are often hedged ('we aim', 'we pledge'). Statistics on patients, countries and R&D spend are presented as factual business description.
